requirements.summary: The debug module is reached through the JTAG TAP: the identification code and dtmcs read as specified, and dmi carries reads and writes.
A halt request, before the first instruction or while the program runs, and an EBREAK with dcsr.ebreakm stop the hart before an instruction; dpc points at it, whatever the pipeline was doing.
A resume is acknowledged and continues at dpc, also after the debugger moved it; the retired instructions are those of an undisturbed run.
With dcsr.step the hart executes one instruction, or takes one exception, and stops again; no interrupt is taken during a step.
While halted, abstract commands read and write the general registers, dcsr and dpc; x0 stays zero and a written value is what the program sees.

A command the module does not have, a register the core does not have, a command while the hart runs and an access while a command runs set cmderr; the error stays, and blocks commands, until it is cleared.
